main_text.p: tat tamen á λύω solvo, exemplum tertii horistici.

λελύμεθα, λελύασθε, λελῶντο, solutus essem, redemptus essem, pro λελυμένος εἴην. Gaza legit per diphthongum λελύμεν. Citatur autem ex Homero λελύτο, & ex alio poëta λελῶντο, circumflexo accentu, ut differat ab horistico quarto.
main_text.head: In μι, horisticum 2.

page.notes: Greek polytonic text is copied as far as legible; accents over the Greek forms in the scan are faint and may be imperfectly rendered. The heading "In μι, horisticum 2." is set in a larger, spaced line and is treated as a level 2 heading.
